Fixes the retry-burn half of the paused-central incident.

What shipped: (1) new failure class `unclaimed` in libs/shared/src/error-classify.ts, added to PERMANENT so getNextTransition refuses the back-edge — the transition module needed NO code change, only tests; (2) new pure libs/shared/src/project/cluster-agents/capacity.ts — capacityFor() returns capable/all-unavailable/none-registered/registry-empty, unclaimedDetail() writes the one sentence both reaper queue-timeout arms use; (3) reaper deps gained now/queueWaitMs/listClusterAgents (wired in cron.ts); (4) FAILURE_CATEGORIES is now an exported runtime array and node-result-schema.ts DERIVES its zod enum from it — it was a hand-copied mirror, and zod drops what it does not declare, so the new class would have been silently erased crossing the station boundary.

Lore's review (ran on the minikube satellite, APPROVED, 3 comments) caught a REAL defect I missed: listClusterAgents was read BEFORE offlineClusterAgents, which MUTATES the registry (production calls markOffline). A cluster that just died read as "capable ... may be wedged". Fixed in 96ebc020 + regression test. Lesson: when a sweep both mutates and reads shared state, order the read after the mutation and pin it with a test.

Process notes worth repeating: (a) reanchor.py must be run EXACTLY ONCE from origin/main — running it twice double-maps your own new links (it treats current line numbers as origin/main numbers). The safe loop is: `git checkout origin/main -- specs/` → reanchor once → re-apply your spec edits with line numbers looked up fresh by test title. I scripted this as scratchpad/apply-specs.py and re-ran it after every test-file change. (b) reanchor's regex misses multi-line `it.each([...])` openers — fix those links by hand. (c) Verify by comparing "test anchors not on an opener" against the origin/main baseline (19 in this repo) rather than expecting zero.
